claims.text: Apixaban 5 mg twice daily was started on 2026-08-01.

Creatinine was 140 umol/L on today's sample (2026-08-20). Age 84, weight 58 kg and creatinine 140 umol/L mean three of the label's listed criteria are present, alongside the apixaban 5 mg twice daily record; this is a labeled dose-criteria conflict for the clinician to resolve.

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Creatinine 140 umol/L with apixaban 5 mg twice daily and recorded age 84 and weight 58 kg meets the label's dose-reduction criteria.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Verify apixaban dosing criteria against recorded age, weight and creatinine.

check_points.text: Confirm whether two or more of age 80 or over, weight 60 kg or less, and creatinine 133 umol/L or more apply, given the recorded age 84, weight 58 kg and creatinine 140 umol/L with apixaban 5 mg twice daily.

reference.quote: Reduce the dose to 2.5 mg twice daily when two of the following apply: age 80 or over, weight 60 kg or less, creatinine 133 umol/L or more.
